ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white base (approx. 65%) contrasted against low-intensity black trailing edges and mid-intensity tan/ochre mottling (approx. 35%).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white central field on both lobes. Large, amorphous tan-colored contiguous blobs located mid-lobe. Continuous black boundary masking the entire trailing edge and lobe tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the black trailing edge boundary; amplitude increases toward the distal tips producing a jagged profile.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature of the trailing edge transitioning into sharply upward-tilted distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Concentrated dark, textured pixel clusters at the terminal tips of both lobes, exhibiting high relief and irregular morphology.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant dark, protruding textural masses on the far lateral tips of both lobes, suggesting heavy colonization or historical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive golden-brown/tan pigmentation patches distributed across the white ventral surface, distinct from the primary black-white pigmentation pattern.
